overview: This enum sets the difficulty tier shown on a Binding Vow icon.

None.simple: The vow is shown as a Special vow.
None.technical: The widget keeps only Low and Middle unchanged, maps High to Hard, and sends every other byte to Special. None therefore selects Special textures. A Special type also makes LevelMaxEffect visible. The shipped BindingVowsDataTable has 21 exported rows with None.

Low.simple: The vow is shown as Easy.
Low.technical: The widget passes the value through as EGameWidgetBindingVowsDifficultType::Easy. That widget type selects DifficultTypeMaskTexture and FrameTexture through the dynamic icon parameter map. The type leaves LevelMaxEffect collapsed. The shipped BindingVowsDataTable has 45 exported rows with Low.

Middle.simple: The vow is shown as Medium.
Middle.technical: The widget passes the value through as EGameWidgetBindingVowsDifficultType::Medium. That widget type selects DifficultTypeMaskTexture and FrameTexture through the dynamic icon parameter map. The type leaves LevelMaxEffect collapsed. The shipped BindingVowsDataTable has 75 exported rows with Middle.

High.simple: The vow is shown as Hard.
High.technical: The widget maps the value to EGameWidgetBindingVowsDifficultType::Hard. That widget type selects DifficultTypeMaskTexture and FrameTexture through the dynamic icon parameter map. The type leaves LevelMaxEffect collapsed. The shipped BindingVowsDataTable has 5 exported rows with High.

Invalid.simple: The vow is shown as a Special vow.
Invalid.technical: No exported row uses Invalid. A row with Invalid would take the fallback branch because it is neither Low, Middle, nor High, and the widget would pass Special to the dynamic icon parameter lookup. A Special type also makes LevelMaxEffect visible.

notes: UGameBindingVowsWidget reads the row Difficulty byte and remaps it before casting to EGameWidgetBindingVowsDifficultType. Low and Middle keep their numeric positions, High stays at the Hard position, and every other value becomes Special.
The dynamic icon parameter lookup uses a map. A missing entry returns a default parameter object.
None is a real exported tier in BindingVowsDataTable with 21 rows.
The traced behavior covers the icon frame, icon mask, and LevelMaxEffect visibility.
